fingerprints.story: The storm had been raging for three days, a relentless assault of salt spray and howling wind that battered the granite cliffs of Blackwood Point. Inside the lantern room, Elias Thorne sat hunched over his workbench, the rhythmic *tick-tock* of the great Fresnel lens rotation providing a steady counterpoint to the chaos outside. But it was not the lens that held his attention; it was the small, brass-feathered creature resting on a velvet cloth
